case.title: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
case.briefing: The new PX pump series needs shaft SH-220 (1.4021). Two suppliers quote: a German job shop and a Polish machining company. Lead time must not exceed 42 days; the line needs parts within 35 days, every day later costs EUR 150. Machined shafts are a leverage category: several capable suppliers, the goal is the lowest total cost. Award one.

Dear partner,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your transparency regarding the competing offer and are committed to finding a mutually beneficial agreement. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.

Our current Angebot is a price of €16.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery EXW.

To support your cost targets and remain competitive, we are pleased to reduce our price to EUR 15.30 per unit. In order to offer this substantial price reduction, we must maintain a lead time of 45 days, as a 35-day lead time would incur additional production costs. Alternatively, with Lieferzeit 45 days: €15.30 per unit. At our standard terms, we can provide a price of €15.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 45 days, delivery EXW.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
